$comment: Deterministic grounding-pass fixtures replayed by Honua.Server.Tests/Features/Grounding/GroundingFixtureReplayTests and by the honua-server-734 eval harness. Each scenario pins a load-bearing slice of the canonical output of the default (deterministic) engine against the built-in process catalog. Keep edits aligned with DeterministicGroundingEngine and BuiltInProcessCatalog — a change on either side should trip the replay.

scenarios.notes: Natural-language buffer request with an explicit layer classifies as Analyze at the High confidence band. The service still emits a clarification because the ranked buffer process has required parameters that are not expressed in the goal — the fixture pins the family and the clarification presence but does not overspecify the process ranking (which can reshuffle as the catalog grows).
Publish verb with an explicit source pins the PublishIntent envelope and wires the source through provenance.

BuildApp family is schema-stable but the typed intent has not shipped — the drafter emits an envelope with the AppBundle requested output and the service returns a PolicyBoundary clarification so the operator confirms the envelope-only mode.

input.goal: Compose a dashboard for incident response

scenarios.notes: AutomateDeploy family is a schema-stable stub awaiting a typed DeployIntent. Same envelope-only confirmation flow as BuildApp.
A vague goal with no family-discriminating verbs falls back to Analyze with low confidence, which the material-ambiguity evaluator trips into a LowConfidence clarification.
An explicit workflowFamilyHint pins the classification at confidence=1.0 with a single 'hint' evidence entry, independent of the goal text.
